title: The newsroom drafts a piece and asks an editor to review it
description:
The automated newsroom ends at a review request, never at a publish.

```gherkin
Feature: Automated drafting

  Scenario: A draft reaches an editor
    Given accepted References
    When the newsroom runs
    Then an idea is chosen, drafted, illustrated and checked
    And an editor receives a review request
    And nothing is published
```
